baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَّن تُغْنِىَ ... أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُهُم ... شَيْـًٔا
baseline_models.mechanism: The sufficiency-and-substitution branch of غ ن ي receives two concrete candidates, accumulated property and descendants, while لَنْ plus the indefinite شَيْئًا reduces their combined efficacy to zero in relation to God.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency, benefit, and standing in for another supply the exact function that the verb denies.
Accumulated property supplies the stored material resource proposed as leverage.
Biological descendants supply the human resource proposed alongside property.
The maximally general knowable thing makes the denial exhaustive rather than merely substantial.

changed_reading.before: Their wealth and children will not help them.
changed_reading.after: Accumulated property and embodied lineage are tested as substitute sources of sufficiency, then denied even the smallest efficacy before or against God.

baseline_models.mechanism: The pair spans two ways of extending the self: possessions preserve acquired stock in the present, while offspring reproduce a person into the future. Their joint negation collapses both accumulated capital and generated legacy as routes to independence.

activation_trace.role: Taking and multiplying wealth supplies the model's accumulated present stock.
Something produced from something else lets offspring function as generated continuation and legacy.
Self-sufficiency and freedom from need name the independence that neither extension can manufacture.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and children are two valued things that fail at judgment.
changed_reading.after: The verse nullifies a whole temporal strategy of self-extension: what one stores and what one reproduces cannot make the self independent of God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Companionship names belonging and sustained association; explicit permanence and the locative فِيهَا then double that bond. Fire is not a passing instrument applied to them but the company and habitat to which they remain attached.

activation_trace.role: Companionship and continual association turn fire into an identity-bearing affiliation.
Kindled fire supplies the concrete environment of that affiliation.
Stable continuance with no quick ending supplies the temporal lock.
Clinging, adhering, and staying sharpen permanence into spatial attachment.

changed_reading.before: They will be punished in fire forever.
changed_reading.after: Their outcome is a double bond of belonging and residence: they become fire's companions and remain fastened within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ shares the packet's sufficiency image with تُغْنِيَ. Wealth and children fail to suffice; the fire they accompany is ironically declared sufficient for them.

activation_trace.role: Denied sufficiency and substitution create the open slot filled ironically by the earlier clause.
The focus verse's fire identifies the same destination named as sufficient in 58:8.
Sufficiency and rendering unnecessary make Hell the counter-sufficiency to their failed assets.

structural_cues: 58:8 places حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ before 58:17's denied sufficiency and explicit fire destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two sufficiency branches and the repeated fire destination; I infer an intentional local reversal in which Hell replaces their expected resources as what suffices them. Alternatively, the two sufficiency expressions may be independent rather than a designed echo.

changed_reading.before: Their resources are simply insufficient to prevent punishment.
changed_reading.after: The verse performs an ironic substitution: wealth and offspring do not suffice for them, while Hell itself is what the preceding discourse says will suffice them.

context_deltas.mechanism: 58:10 denies secret counsel any harmful effect شَيْئًا except by divine permission and redirects reliance to God; 58:17 symmetrically denies wealth and offspring any beneficial effect شَيْئًا against God. The pair bounds both harm and help within divine jurisdiction.

activation_trace.role: Benefit, adequacy, and substitution provide the helpful-agency side of the symmetry.
The same unrestricted 'anything' quantifier makes the earlier limitation formally comparable.
Permission and authorization supply the jurisdictional condition on created causal power.
Reliance redirects dependence away from created means and toward God.

structural_cues: 58:10 and 58:17 each negate a created means plus شَيْئًا while naming God as the governing relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel absolute-thing constructions, divine permission, and reliance; I infer a two-sided causal rule covering both harm and benefit. Alternatively, 58:10 may address comfort in the present while 58:17 only addresses eschatological rescue.

changed_reading.before: These particular assets happen to fail in the final crisis.
changed_reading.after: Their failure exemplifies a wider agency limit: no created means possesses autonomous power to harm, help, or substitute across God's authorization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah earlier makes material giving operative as charity, right, and purification. Thus the focus does not erase material agency altogether; it contrasts possessed wealth treated as reserve leverage with wealth relinquished through commanded action.

activation_trace.role: Acquired and multiplied property supplies the held stock whose mere possession is denied efficacy.
Charity as money and due right supplies a packet-local mode in which property becomes accountable action.
Purity and rectification make transferred wealth morally transformative rather than merely retained stock.

structural_cues: 58:3-4 prescribes release, fasting, or feeding; 58:12-13 moves from alms before counsel to established almsgiving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies owned wealth, monetary charity/right, and purification; I infer that conversion from possession into prescribed transfer changes wealth's function. Alternatively, 58:17 may distinguish only worldly use from final judgment, without implying a possession-versus-circulation contrast.

changed_reading.before: Material wealth has no meaningful religious efficacy.
changed_reading.after: Wealth is not inert: retained wealth cannot serve as substitute leverage, whereas wealth surrendered as a due act can participate in purification before the crisis arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: 58:16 explicitly turns oaths into a protective shield, and 58:18 shows oath-making continuing before God. Positioned between them, 58:17 exposes wealth and children as a second, material-dynastic shield that fails with the verbal one.

activation_trace.role: Standing in for, benefiting, and sufficing name the protective job assigned to assets and offspring.
The oath branch supplies the verbal defense that the sequence explicitly weaponizes as cover.
A protecting shield supplies the concrete defense architecture extended to property and lineage.
Repeated swearing after resurrection shows the failed verbal shield being carried into the final scene.

structural_cues: 58:14-18 runs from knowingly false oaths, to oaths taken as a shield, to failed wealth and children, and back to oaths before God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit oath-shield, the focus's denied rescue resources, and renewed oaths; I infer a layered defense system whose verbal, material, and dynastic parts fail together. Alternatively, wealth and children may be a conventional independent warning rather than another shield in the sequence.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and children are isolated examples of things unable to rescue them.
changed_reading.after: They are one layer in a whole failed defense system: fabricated speech, accumulated property, and lineage are successively deployed as cover but cannot shield anyone from God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus denies that their resources avail شَيْئًا; the next ayah says they reckon themselves عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ. The repeated general noun turns the focus's minimizer into a direct answer to a false status claim: what they count as standing amounts to nothing.

activation_trace.role: The unrestricted knowable 'thing' provides the zero term in the focus verse.
Reckoning and supposition frame their claimed standing as a mistaken self-assessment.
The repeated 'thing' converts abstract total negation into the object of their false claim.

structural_cues: 58:18 immediately repeats شَيْء after 58:17 and closes by identifying them as the liars.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent identical roots, total negation, mistaken reckoning, and a lie verdict; I infer that the second 'thing' exposes the precise illusion zeroed by the first. Alternatively, each شَيْء may function independently as an ordinary indefinite expression.

changed_reading.before: شَيْئًا merely intensifies the statement as 'not at all.'
changed_reading.after: The zero in 58:17 answers 58:18's imagined status: their wealth and children make them think they stand on something, but that supposed something has no effective substance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus moves from personal holdings to أَصْحَابُ, and 58:19 immediately names a party united on an orientation and calls it commercially losing. Their apparent balance sheet of wealth and offspring is overridden by the affiliation to which they belong.

activation_trace.role: Accumulated wealth supplies the positive-looking side of the apparent balance sheet.
Companionship shifts evaluation from what they own to the company and identity they inhabit.
A group cohering around an orientation gives social form to the focus verse's companionship.
Commercial loss reverses the apparent value of their accumulated assets into a failed total account.

structural_cues: 58:17's أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ and companions-of-fire designation are followed by 58:19's repeated أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ, party designation, and loss verdict.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies holdings, companionship, ideological grouping, and commercial loss; I infer a shift from an asset ledger to an affiliation ledger. Alternatively, the loss branch may be a general outcome image without deliberate commercial interaction with wealth.

changed_reading.before: Prosperous individuals lose their possessions' help and enter fire.
changed_reading.after: The decisive account is corporate and relational, not proprietary: however rich their household ledger appears, belonging to this party registers as total loss and companionship with fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: 58:22 expands offspring into a graded kinship network, explicitly placing sons and clan inside an allegiance test. This changes أَوْلَادُهُمْ from merely potential rescuers or heirs into the most intimate social bonds that cannot override relation to God.

activation_trace.role: Biological descendants anchor the focus verse in literal family continuity.
Companionship opens the focus outcome toward competing forms of belonging.
Sonship and lineage place children within descent-based identity and allegiance.
Clan and kin-group widen offspring into the social network normally expected to protect its members.

structural_cues: 58:22 enumerates fathers, sons, brothers, and clan against allegiance to those opposing God, then names the party of God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies offspring, sonship/lineage, clan, and opposed party belonging; I infer that family is being evaluated as a loyalty-and-protection network, not only as biological intercession. Alternatively, the family list in 58:22 may illustrate loyalty separately from 58:17's rescue denial.

changed_reading.before: Children cannot intervene for their parents at judgment.
changed_reading.after: Children represent an entire descent-based allegiance network; the verse denies that even the closest inherited belonging can displace the belonging constituted in relation to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: 58:22 repeats the focus's خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا construction but changes the containing environment from kindled fire to enclosed gardens. Permanence is the shared frame; affiliation and destination determine what fills it.

activation_trace.role: Kindled fire supplies the focus half of the opposed destination pair.
Unfailing continuance supplies the shared temporal frame.
A garden enclosed and concealed by trees supplies the contrasting containing environment.
The repeated permanence branch confirms that duration is deliberately held constant across destinations.

structural_cues: 58:17 and 58:22 use the same plural abiding predicate plus فِيهَا for opposed communal destinations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact permanence formula in fire and gardens; I infer a designed destination diptych in which the same duration exposes the consequence of different belonging. Alternatively, the repeated formula may be conventional afterlife diction without a close contrastive function.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse independently emphasizes endless punishment.
changed_reading.after: Its permanence is one half of a matched destination structure: abiding itself is constant, while the community one belongs to resolves into fire or garden.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links two distinct derivations of ج ن ن across six verses rather than treating either as the lexical meaning of a focus word. It remains anchored through the focus's denied protective efficacy and fire destination, with 58:16's shield and 58:22's garden flanking it. Downstream prose should present it only as a possible root-and-sequence resonance, not as a translation claim.

activation_trace.role: Denied benefit and substitution anchor the outlier in the focus's failed protection mechanism.
Fire supplies the middle destination between the two contrasting forms of cover.
The protective shield supplies a self-fashioned covering immediately before the focus.
The tree-concealed garden supplies a granted enclosure at the surah's opposite outcome.

changed_reading.before: The oath-shield, fire, and gardens are three separate images.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, 58:17 is the hinge in a movement from counterfeit self-covering (جُنَّة) through exposed failure in fire to true granted enclosure (جَنَّات).

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the flight-and-instability branch is remote from the ordinary fire sense of نَار and must not replace it. It remains anchored by the packet's shared mapped root for the focus word and by the explicit permanence root beside it. Downstream prose should qualify it as an imagistic tension: fixed duration inside a restless medium, not a lexical gloss.

activation_trace.role: Kindled fire preserves the direct lexical anchor for the image.
Flight and lack of stability supply an exploratory quality of restless motion within the fire.
Stable, unending continuance fixes the duration against the fire's exploratory instability image.

changed_reading.before: Eternal fire is imagined as a static state of confinement.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the state is temporally fixed but experientially restless: permanent confinement within a flickering, repelling, unstable medium.

strongest_changes: The sufficiency branches turn the verse into an ironic exchange: property and offspring do not suffice, while 58:8 says Hell suffices them.
The 58:14-18 sequence reframes property and lineage as one layer in a failed defense system built from false speech, shields, assets, and renewed oaths.
Adjacent شَيْء language makes the focus's total zero answer the next ayah's false belief that they stand on something.
58:22 expands children into an allegiance network and mirrors the focus's permanence formula in gardens, making destination follow belonging.
summary.what_was_special: The strongest activations came from compact mechanism-level echoes rather than broad themes: sufficiency answered by counter-sufficiency, an explicit shield extended into material and dynastic defenses, a repeated 'thing' that converts quantification into forensic rebuttal, and matched permanence across opposed communities.
remaining_uncertainties: The حَسْبُهُمْ and تُغْنِيَ sufficiency reversal is branch-exact but may be reader-level wordplay rather than a deliberate lexical echo.
The harm/help symmetry with 58:10 may join present and eschatological agency more tightly than the sequence requires.
The جُنَّة-to-جَنَّات corridor and the instability branch of ن و ر should remain explicitly exploratory.
